_note: Words of the Trio shortcut. Placeholders {C} {P} {T} {R} are wired by src/build_trio.py — keep them.
name: Trio
comment: Trio — ChatGPT answers, Claude checks, a third AI from another company names only what both missed. The third voice works on a FREE key (Google AI Studio or Groq) kept in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt — never inside this shortcut, so sharing the shortcut never shares the key. ChatGPT: Start new chat ON, Continuous OFF.
ask.question: What do you want to ask the trio?
ask.key:
Step 1 of 2. Paste your FREE Gemini key — it is the third voice (asked once, saved in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, never inside the shortcut).

Get it in a minute, no card: aistudio.google.com/apikey → Create API key → Copy.
notify.start: 🎻 Trio [1/3]: ChatGPT answers… ≈1.5 min, don't touch the phone. If ChatGPT says «logged out» — open its app and rerun Trio.
notify.step2: [2/3] Claude is checking and writing the final answer…
notify.step3: [3/3] The third voice is looking for what both missed… (Claude's answer is already in the clipboard)
notify.retry: The third voice is busy — trying once more in 10 seconds…
notify.done: ✅ Trio: the answer and the third voice are in the clipboard
error.limit: ⚠️ The free limit of the third voice is reached. Gemini allows about 5 requests a minute and 20 a day: wait a minute and run again; if it repeats, today's limit is spent — it comes back tomorrow. Groq: a very long answer may not fit its free tier — ask a shorter question. Claude's answer above is complete.
error.key: ⚠️ The key did not work (invalid or deleted). Open Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts, delete poly-key.txt and run Trio again — it will ask for a new key. A free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey (Gemini) or console.groq.com/keys (Groq, the stand-in).
error.busy: ⚠️ The third voice is overloaded right now (the provider says «high demand»). Run Trio again in a minute. Claude's answer above is complete.
error.model: ⚠️ The provider has renamed or withdrawn the model. Download the fresh Trio: polyhelper.ai/duo
error.other: ⚠️ The third voice did not answer (no internet, or the provider refused). What it sent back:
ask.key2:
Step 2 of 2 (optional). A FREE Groq key — the stand-in when Gemini's daily limit is spent or it is overloaded. No card: console.groq.com/keys → Create API Key (starts with gsk_).

No Groq key — just tap Done.
notify.fallback: Gemini is unavailable today — Qwen on Groq takes the third voice…
provider.groq_fallback: Qwen · Groq — Gemini is unavailable today
